# End-to-end results

Run 2026-11-02. Raw input was each style's demo video from `Tài liệu` (`video demo m1.mp4`, `video demo s1.mp4`). Those demos are **already finished edits** (captions, cards and graphics burned in), so our overlays are drawn on top of the originals and some elements appear twice. This run proves the pipeline, not the visual match; a fair visual comparison needs un-edited raw footage.

"Director" steps (`plan.json`) were generated by `tests/e2e/make-plan-m1.ts` and `make-plan-s1.ts` from `transcript.json`, following each style's `rules.md`. The transcript came from faster-whisper `small` with no manual correction.

| | m1 | s1 |
|---|---|---|
| Output | `projects/m1-e2e/out.mp4`, 1080x1920, 48.4 s | `projects/s1-e2e/out.mp4`, 1080x1920, 75.9 s |
| `init` + `clean` | 1 min 37 s; 1 cut, 236 words | 1 min 33 s; 1 cut, 374 words |
| Plan | 66 captions, 7 other layers | 51 captions, 12 other layers |
| `validate` | round 1: 2 errors (`out-of-bounds`, plan outlasted the video by 5 ms); fixed in the generator; round 2: no issues | round 1: no issues |
| Editor | opened, dragged title `t1` +0.5 s (1.5 → 2.0), saved | not opened in this run |
| Render | 86 s, started from the editor's Render button | 1 min 57 s, from `cli render` |
| Warnings left | none | none |

## Comparison with the demos (by eye, contact sheets of the output)

What matches:
- m1: yellow highlight boxes on key words in large caption, black background scenes, chip stack with Typography / Graphic / Motion / Âm thanh, blur transition into a black explainer scene, title cards in black with a yellow outline.
- s1: small caption with teal key words, navy glass title cards with icon, title and sub-line, full-screen navy explainer scenes with a list and a round avatar, orange accent on the cost card.

Gaps (not bugs, not fixed in this version):
- Title cards are boxed; the s1 demo uses frameless icon + text with an underline, and 3D illustrated icons. Ours are simple line icons.
- No staggered build-up inside a card (icon first, then title, then sub-line), and chips in m1 appear together with their own animation but not with the demo's easing.
- Explainer scenes show a plain list; the s1 demo uses waveform, phone mock-up and UI screenshots (`MockupCard` was left out of the first version).
- No intro/outro scene (`IntroOutro` not built), no sound effects.
- m1 captions are one chunk at a time, the demo builds two lines word by word.
- Transcript errors from Whisper `small` flow straight into captions ("true editor" for "trực tiếp editor", "Claudeover .5" for "Claude Opus 5.5"). Captions must match transcript words to pass the sync check, so correcting them needs a transcript-correction step that does not exist yet.

## Bug found and fixed in this run
- `ExplainerScene`: with `avatar: true` a long title ran under the avatar circle (visible in the s1 sheet: "AI CHẠY QUY TRÌN…"). Fixed by reserving room beside label and title (`titleInset`); covered by `tests/remotion/explainer-layout.test.ts`. The two e2e videos above were rendered **before** this fix.
